title: TenK10K Phase 1 effector genes: inputs for the figures and tables
description: Summary-level data needed to rebuild every figure and supplementary table of Single-cell genetics identifies cell type-specific causal mechanisms in complex traits and diseases (medRxiv doi:10.1101/2025.08.28.25334614) with the companion code release (make data downloads and verifies this record). INVENTORY.tsv lists each file with its size, SHA-256, the display items that use it, its source and its licence. No individual-level data or genotypes are included; cell-level scDRS files carry anonymised cell identifiers.
